critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2010 lines — same guideline breach noted since iter12/iter13. Iter14 added PERMISSION_KEYS/ROLE_DEFAULT_PERMS/user_perms/clean_perms/require_perm just above line 100; consider extracting to backend/permissions.py so business modules can import cleanly and to keep server.py under 700 LOC.

Frontend PERMISSION_KEYS/ROLE_DEFAULT_PERMS in /app/frontend/src/lib/perms.js are duplicated from backend server.py — they can drift silently. Consider exposing a `/api/perms/meta` endpoint or generating perms.js from a shared JSON so backend is the single source of truth.

clean_perms() preserves insertion order but PATCH stores whatever order the client sent — tests use set() comparison. If UI ever depends on ordering (e.g. reporting), sort the list before storing for determinism.

In user_perms(), an empty `permissions: []` list falls through to ROLE_DEFAULT_PERMS (because of `len(p) > 0` check). That means owners cannot explicitly revoke ALL access without deleting a member — save with 0 checkboxes silently reverts to role default. Consider treating empty list as 'no perms at all' or forcing at least one perm at save time in the UI.

Inbox 'inbox-upload-button' gating relies on hasPerm(user,'data_input'); the Ingest route itself is not wrapped in a ProtectedRoute, so a determined URL-typist reaches /ingest and sees the View-only EmptyState — fine, but the /voice-notes and /voice-notes/text endpoints are still gated by require_role('owner') (not require_perm), which mixes the two authz models. Consider migrating those to require_perm('data_input') for consistency (owner is auto-authorized via user_perms bypass).

The Ask AI money-restriction message is achieved by injecting different system-prompt text based on money_access — the LLM may occasionally still leak partial numbers if any slipped into decisions/tasks context. Adding explicit redaction of amount fields in the non-finance context would be safer.

Team.js MemberDialog uses button-styled chips (data-testid=perm-*) instead of native <input type=checkbox>. That's fine for a11y since role=button + toggle state is announced, but adding `aria-pressed={on}` would improve screen-reader UX.

MemberDialog#save: when create fails with a validation error, form state is preserved — good; but when API returns 400 (duplicate email etc), toast shows raw formatApiError result — no field-level highlight. Minor UX polish.

In Layout.js the mobile bottom nav (BOTTOM_NAV) doesn't gate 'Brief' or 'Work' — those are always shown. Correct per spec (My Work/Daily Brief/CEO Brief remain for everyone), but note that /my-work is not in the perm-gated NAV either; if 'My Work' should require an assignment perm, add one.
